Product 01

Founder's digital avatar

You reply to one message. A film goes out in your face, in your voice, cut and graded and ready to post.

Founders know they should be posting. Almost none of them have forty minutes a day to write, shoot, edit and upload. This removes every part of that except the one part only you can do, which is having the opinion.

It starts as a message.

Not a dashboard you have to remember to open. Telegram or WhatsApp, wherever you already are, every morning.

Your involvement is two taps and one sentence. Everything after that happens without you.

How it runs

01

The digest

Your niche, the last twenty-four hours, filtered through your persona. It arrives before you are at your desk.

02

You pick, you react

One tap on the point worth saying something about. One line of what you actually think. That is the whole of your involvement.

03

Your avatar speaks

Looks like you, sounds like you, phrases it the way you would. The script is written out of your line, not around it.

04

The edit happens

B-roll, motion graphics, captions, cuts. The film comes back finished, not as footage waiting for someone.

05

It goes out

LinkedIn or Instagram, video or static, cut the way that platform actually rewards.

One sentence in. A finished film out.

What you typed

Time spent

What went out

The hard part is not the video.

Anyone can generate a talking head now. Almost nobody can generate one that sounds like you.

The work is upstream of the camera. How you build an argument. The words you would never use. Where you stop short of the obvious point, because the obvious point bores you. Your aesthetic, which is a real thing even if you have never written it down.

We spend the first stretch there, not on the model. Get it wrong and it is a stranger wearing your face. Get it right and your own team stops being able to tell.
